e.title: **一个没有说明书的 .NET 精算现金流引擎：**5,106 次下载、**无许可、**无仓库、**描述里还有一个拼写错****：NuGet 包 `ActuarialLibrary`——**⭐ 最后发布 **2018-04-20****；**⭐ 而**本次把包体解开后**，**从一个 **78,336 字节的 DLL** 里读出 **207 个类型名**：**年金／**现金流投影、**养老金增长、**退休日、**抵押贷款类型、**权益假设、**历史收益率、**封顶与**完全通胀、**生命数据**；**⚠️ 而**它**只发布过两个版本**、**唯一一次变更说明**是**换了一个 CSV 库的版本****
e.title_en: A .NET actuarial cash-flow engine with no documentation: five thousand downloads, no licence, no repository, and a typo in its own description. Its last release was in April 2018, yet unpacking the package reveals two hundred and seven type names in a single seventy-eight kilobyte assembly, covering cash-flow projection, pension increases, retirement dates, mortgage types, equity assumptions, inflation capping and life data.
e.title_hk: **一個沒有說明書的 .NET 精算現金流引擎：**5,106 次下載、**無許可、**無倉庫、**描述裡還有一個拼寫錯****：NuGet 包 `ActuarialLibrary`——**⭐ 最後發布 2018-04-20****；**⭐ 而**本次把包體解開後**，**從一個 78,336 位元組的 DLL** 裡讀出 **207 個型別名**：**年金／**現金流投影、**養老金增長、**退休日、**抵押貸款類型、**權益假設、**歷史收益率、**封頂與**完全通脹、**生命資料**；**⚠️ 而**它**只發布過兩個版本**、**唯一一次變更說明**是**換了一個 CSV 庫的版本****
e.summary: **ActuarialLibrary**（NuGet 包 `ActuarialLibrary`）**是一个面向 .NET 的**精算类库****——**逐字自述为**「**A.Net Core Class Library for developing methods and Models for use in acturial work**」**（**⭐ 其中**「**acturial**」**是该包自己的**拼写错**）**。**本次实测**：**共两个版本**（**1.0.0 **2018-04-17**、**1.0.1 **2018-04-20**）**、**累计下载 **5,106 次****、**目标框架 **.NETCoreApp2.0****、**作者与所有者同为两个姓名**；**⚠️ 而**元数据里**没有**许可**、**也没有**仓库或**项目主页****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **唯一一次变更说明**逐字为**「**Updated CsvHelper from v 2.16.3 to v 7.1.0**」**——**⭐ 即**这个库**七年多来**留给读者的**全部变更记录**就是**换了一个 CSV 解析库的版本**；**② **包体解开后**：**6 个文件／**约 108 KB**，**核心是一个 **78,336 字节的 DLL****；**③ **⭐ 从该 DLL 里读出 **207 个类型名**，**它们**拼出一个**完整的**精算现金流投影框架**（**见下**）**；**④ **⚠️ **无许可**意味着**默认保留全部权利**——**⭐ 5,106 次下载**与**可合法使用**是两件事**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未调用**；**⭐ 而**本次**把包体解开了**。
e.summary_hk: **ActuarialLibrary**（NuGet 包 `ActuarialLibrary`）**是一個面向 .NET 的**精算類庫****——**逐字自述為**「**A.Net Core Class Library for developing methods and Models for use in acturial work**」**（**⭐ 其中**「**acturial**」**是該包自己的**拼寫錯**）**。**本次實測**：**共兩個版本**（**1.0.0 於 2018-04-17、**1.0.1 於 2018-04-20**）**、**累計下載 5,106 次****、**目標框架 .NETCoreApp2.0****；**⚠️ 而**元資料裡**沒有**許可**、**也沒有**倉庫或專案主頁****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一個登記處：企業側的包登記**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **唯一一次變更說明**逐字為**「**Updated CsvHelper from v 2.16.3 to v 7.1.0**」**——**⭐ 即**這個庫**留給讀者的全部變更記錄**就是**換了一個 CSV 解析庫的版本**；**② **包體解開後**：**6 個檔案／**約 108 KB**，**核心是一個 78,336 位元組的 DLL****；**③ **⭐ 從該 DLL 裡讀出 207 個型別名**，**它們**拼出一個**完整的精算現金流投影框架****；**④ **⚠️ **無許可**意味著**默認保留全部權利**——**⭐ 下載數**與**可合法使用**是兩件事**。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未調用**；**⭐ 而本次**把包體解開了**。
e.summary_en: This NuGet package **is an actuarial class library for .NET**, described verbatim as a library for developing methods and models for actuarial work, with a spelling mistake inside its own description. **Measured this round**: two versions published three days apart in April 2018, five thousand one hundred and six total downloads, and a target framework that has long since left support. **The metadata declares no licence and gives neither a repository nor a project page.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.** **Four things are worth reading: the library only change note in seven years is a sentence about updating one CSV parsing dependency; unpacking the package yields six files in about a hundred and eight kilobytes around a single seventy-eight kilobyte assembly; that assembly exposes two hundred and seven type names that together describe a complete actuarial cash-flow projection framework; and the absence of any licence means all rights are reserved by default, so five thousand downloads and lawful reuse are two different things.** **The package was not installed and not called, but the package body was unpacked.**
e.body:
**ActuarialLibrary**（NuGet 包 `ActuarialLibrary`）**是一个面向 .NET 的**精算类库****——**逐字自述为**「**A.Net Core Class Library for developing methods and Models for use in acturial work**」**（**⭐ 其中**「**acturial**」**是该包自己的**拼写错**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。

**可核实信息（均 NuGet 元数据、登记资源与包体实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七年多只有一次变更说明，**而它说的是换了一个依赖的版本****——**1.0.1 的变更说明逐字为**「**Updated CsvHelper from v 2.16.3 to v 7.1.0**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一处最值得记**：**⭐ 即**一个库**对外公开的**全部变更历史**，**可以只有**一句**依赖升级**——**⭐ 而**这**并不等于**它**没有再改**，**而是**它**没有告诉读者**改了**什么**；**⭐ 与之对照**，本会话已多次记下**「**说清改了什么**」**的做法**（**如**逐字列出**改动的分析流程与**md5 校验**）**——**⭐ 本条**补上的是**反面的形态**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 包体解开后：**6 个文件／**约 108 KB****——**结构极简**（`_rels`、**`[Content_Types].xml`、**签名文件、**nuspec 与**一份 **DLL**）**，**核心是 **`lib/netcoreapp2.0/ActuarialLibrary.dll`，**逐字 **78,336 字节****；**⭐ 即**它**没有** README**、**没有**示例、**没有**许可文件、**也没有**任何文档文件**——**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**一个 **78 KB 的库**里**装着**一个**完整的业务框架**，**而**包里**一个字**都没有解释它**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 从 DLL 里读出 **207 个类型名**，**它们拼出一个**精算现金流投影框架****——**⭐ 本次**按名字分类记录如下**（**⭐ 本词条**明确说明**：**这是**从二进制字符串读出的**名称清单**，**⭐ 它**是**线索**，**不是** API 契约**，**更不是**功能证明**）**：**① **现金流核心**：**`ActuarialCashFlow`、**`ActuarialCashFlowItem`、**`CashFlowModel`、**`CashFlowItemType`、**`CashFlowItems`、**`CashFlowResult`、**`CashFlowOutput`、**`CashFlowSummaryOutput`、**`CashFlowProjectionType`、**`NumberOfCashFlows`**；**② **计算与参数**：**`ActuarialFunctions`、**`ActuarialParameter`、**`ActuarialResult`、**`ActuarialCodes`、**`CalculationManager`、**`CalculationManagerForBlobs`、**`CalculationType`、**`CalculationFrequency`、**`ParameterType`、**`GetParameterDbl`／**`GetParameterInt`／**`GetParameterStr`**；**③ **养老与给付**：**`DateOfRetirement`、**`DateOfNextIncrease`、**`PensionIncreaseAmount`、**`IncreaseType`、**`NoIncreases`、**`CompleteDays`／**`CompleteMonths`／**`CompleteYears`、**`DateDifferenceCalculation`、**`DateDiffCalcType`**；**④ **经济假设**：**`EquityAssumptions`、**`EquityAdjustment`、**`HistoricRateOfReturn`、**`InterestRate`、**`FixedRate`、**`CappedInflation`、**`FullInflation`、**`FutureInflationRate`、**`GrossPandLAmount`**；**⑤ **负债与费用**：**`MortgageType`、**`MortgageFees`、**`ChargeFixedAmount`、**`ChargeRateAmount`、**`ChargeRateParameters`**；**⑥ **生命数据与输入**：**`Life1Data`、**`Life2Data`、**`get_TransformSettings02LifeData`、**`InputDataComments`、**`ActuarialComment`、**`ActuarialCommentList`、**`CalculationCommentType`**；**⑦ **数据进出**（**这是最能说明它**面向什么场景**的一组**）**：**`LoadFromCSV`、**`LoadFromBlob`、**`CashFlowFromCSV`、**`CashFlowFromBlob`、**`OutputCashFlowsToFile`、**`ExportDataToXMLBlobAsync`、**`ExportDataToXMLFile`、**`ExportDataToJsonBlob`、**`CreateXSLBlob`／**`CreateXSLFile`、**`SQLTableName`、**`FileInformationLocal`、**`CloudBlob`／**`CloudBlockBlob`／**`CloudBlobStream`**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ⑦ 组**最值得看**：**⭐ 即**它**同时写着**「**CSV 文件**」**与**「**Azure Blob**」**两条进出路径**（**⭐ 依赖里也确有** `WindowsAzure.Storage` **与** `Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions`**）**——**⭐ 故**可以**合理推断**（**⭐ 并**明确标注为推断**）**它**当年是**为**在云上跑**定期现金流投影**而写**；**⭐ 本词条**不主张**任何关于其**正确性**或**适用监管口径**的判断**。**⭐⭐ ④ 依赖组也说明它属于**哪个年代****——**四依赖逐字为**：**`CsvHelper` **7.1.0**、**`Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions` **3.0.0-beta3**、**`SharpZipLib` **1.0.0-alpha2**、**`WindowsAzure.Storage` **8.7.0****——**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**其中两个**是**预发布版本**（**beta3 与**alpha2**）**，**而**目标框架是 **.NETCoreApp2.0****；**⭐ 即**这是一个**2018 年**在**早期 .NET Core 与**Azure Functions 上**做的项目**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 无许可、**无仓库、**无项目主页**——**⭐ 本次实测**三项**字段均缺失**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实说明**：**按**著作权默认规则**，**未声明许可**意味着**保留全部权利****——**⭐ 故**该包**可以被下载 5,106 次**，**而**这不表示**任何人**都可以**在**自己的系统中**使用或**再分发**它**；**⭐ 这一形态**本会话**此前已记为**「**沉默的许可**」**，**本词条**指出这是**同一形态**在**企业侧登记处**的再现**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fastcashflow]]、**[[cashflower]]、**[[projectionmodels]]、**[[lifelib-products]]、**[[modelx]]、**[[psrwp]] 覆盖**现金流投影与**模型库**（**多为 Python／**R 生态**）**，**[[actuarialmath]] 覆盖**精算数学**——**⭐ 并**如实指出**：**本站另有一条**同名而不同生态**的条目 [[proteusllp-actuarial-library]]（**⭐ 那是 **Python 生态的随机建模库**，**与本条的 **.NET 类库**是两个不同之物**，**本词条**未做代码级比较**）**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**.NET 生态里的**精算现金流引擎**，**公开可读的说明为零**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得记的是**三个不等式**：**① **下载数 ≠ 可用性**（**5,106 次下载**与**是否有许可**无关**）**；**② **包里有代码 ≠ 有人能读懂它**（**78 KB 的 DLL、**零文档**）**；**③ **类型名一致 ≠ 口径一致**（**同一个 `CashFlowModel` 在**不同机构**可能指**不同的**投影假设**）**。**⭐ 并**留一个可执行的提醒**：**若**某机构**想复用**这样一个库**，**先要**确认**许可与**维护责任**，**再谈**口径**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用其任何方法**（**未做任何现金流投影、**未算任何年金或**准备金**）**，**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**、**不主张**其任何计算结果**、**也不主张**其**框架设计**是否正确**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **类型名清单来自二进制字符串**（**本次共读出 207 个**）**——**⭐ 本词条**明确声明**：**这是**线索**，**不是** API 契约**；**未做**程序集元数据反射**，**故**无法确认**这些类型的**可见性**（**公开／**内部）**、**签名与**相互调用关系**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其**算法是否符合**任何**精算标准**（**如**折现方式、**生命表插值、**通胀封顶规则**）**——**⭐ 而**这**恰恰是**使用前**必须核实的一处**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `Life1Data`／`Life2Data` **指向**哪一套生命表**，**也**未核实**其**来源与**许可**。**⑤ ⚠️ **许可缺失**——**⭐ 本词条**不主张**其**可被自由使用**；**⭐ 并**如实提示**：**这一处**须由**使用机构**自行与**权利人**确认**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**作者身份**（**元数据里**逐字为两个姓名**，**本词条**不复述**其**可能的机构归属**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**该包与其**可能对应的**生产系统**的关系**（**⭐ 本词条**不做此类推测**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**两个版本**发布于 **2018-04-17 与 **2018-04-20**（**远在解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**.NET 生态里的**精算现金流引擎**：**下载量在千级**、**而**许可、**仓库与**文档**三项**同时缺席**」这一形态**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该包**不是**任何持牌精算意见**，**其**假设与**算法**必须**在使用前**独立复核**。

**可核實資訊（均 NuGet 元資料、登記資源與包體實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七年多只有一次變更說明，**而它說的是換了一個依賴的版本****——**1.0.1 的變更說明逐字為**「**Updated CsvHelper from v 2.16.3 to v 7.1.0**」**；**⭐ 即**一個庫**對外公開的**全部變更歷史**，**可以只有**一句**依賴升級**——**⭐ 78,336 位元組****；**⭐ 即**它**沒有 README**、**沒有示例**、**沒有許可檔**、**沒有文檔檔**——**⭐ 一個 78 KB 的庫裡**裝著**一個完整的業務框架**，**而**包裡**一個字**都沒有解釋它**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 從 DLL 裡讀出 207 個型別名**，**它們拼出一個**精算現金流投影框架****——**⭐ 本次**按名字分類記錄**（**⭐ 明確說明**：**這是**從二進位字符串讀出的名稱清單**，**是線索**，**不是** API 契約**，**更不是**功能證明**）**：**① **現金流核心**：`ActuarialCashFlow`、`ActuarialCashFlowItem`、`CashFlowModel`、`CashFlowItemType`、`CashFlowResult`、`CashFlowOutput`、`CashFlowSummaryOutput`、`CashFlowProjectionType`**；**② **資料進出**（**最能說明它面向什麼場景的一組**）**：`LoadFromCSV`、`LoadFromBlob`、`CashFlowFromCSV`、`CashFlowFromBlob`、`OutputCashFlowsToFile`、`ExportDataToXMLBlobAsync`、`ExportDataToXMLFile`、`ExportDataToJsonBlob`、`CreateXSLBlob`／`CreateXSLFile`、`SQLTableName`、`CloudBlob`／`CloudBlockBlob`／`CloudBlobStream`**。**⭐ 第 ⑦ 組最值得看**：**⭐ 即**它**同時寫著**「**CSV 檔案**」**與**「**Azure Blob**」**兩條進出路徑**（**依賴裡也確有 `WindowsAzure.Storage` 與 `Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions`**）**——**⭐ 故可合理推斷**（**並標明為推斷**）**它**當年是為在雲上跑定期現金流投影而寫**。**⭐⭐ ④ 依賴組說明它屬於哪個年代**：`CsvHelper` 7.1.0、`Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions` 3.0.0-beta3、`SharpZipLib` 1.0.0-alpha2、`WindowsAzure.Storage` 8.7.0**——**⭐ 5,106 次**，**而**這不表示**任何人**都可以**使用或再分發**；**⭐ 同一形態**在**企業側登記處**再現**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[fastcashflow]]、[[cashflower]]、[[projectionmodels]]、[[lifelib-products]]、[[modelx]]、[[psrwp]]、[[actuarialmath]]；**⭐ 並**如實指出**：**本站另有一條**同名而不同生態**的條目 [[proteusllp-actuarial-library]]（**那是 Python 生態的隨機建模庫**，**與本條的 .NET 類庫**是兩個不同之物**，**本詞條未做代碼級比較**）**——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**.NET 生態的精算現金流引擎，**公開可讀的說明為零**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 最值得記的是三個不等式**：**① **下載數 ≠ 可用性**；**② **包裡有代碼 ≠ 有人能讀懂它**；**③ **型別名一致 ≠ 口徑一致**。**⭐ 並留一個可執行的提醒**：**若想複用這樣一個庫**，**先確認許可與維護責任**，**再談口徑**。

This NuGet package **is an actuarial class library for .NET**, described verbatim as a library for developing methods and models for actuarial work, a description that contains a misspelling of the word actuarial. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the registration resources and the unpacked package**: **first, seven years of published history contain exactly one change note, and it is about a dependency version** — the release note for the later version states verbatim that the CSV parsing library was updated from version 2.16.3 to version 7.1.0. **That is worth recording: the entire change history a library makes public can be one sentence about an upgrade, which does not mean nothing else changed, only that readers were not told what did.** **Second, unpacking the package yields six files in about a hundred and eight kilobytes around a single assembly of seventy-eight thousand three hundred and thirty-six bytes**, with no readme, no examples, no licence file and no documentation file, **so a complete business framework sits inside seventy-eight kilobytes and not one word in the package explains it**. **Third, the assembly exposes two hundred and seven type names that together describe an actuarial cash-flow projection framework**, and this entry records them by group while stating plainly that **names read out of a compiled binary are clues rather than an API contract or proof of capability**, no assembly metadata reflection having been performed. The groups are: cash-flow core types covering flows, models, items, results, outputs and projection types; calculation and parameter types including an actuarial functions type, a calculation manager and typed parameter getters; pension and benefit types covering retirement dates, next increase dates, pension increase amounts and complete service periods; economic assumption types covering equity assumptions and adjustments, historic rates of return, interest rates, capped and full inflation, future inflation rates and a gross profit and loss amount; liability and charge types covering mortgage types and fees and fixed or rate-based charges; life data and input types including two life data types and comment types; and finally the input and output group, which is the most telling. **That last group names both a CSV path and an Azure Blob path for loading and exporting cash flows, alongside XML and JSON export, XSL creation, a SQL table name and cloud blob types, and the dependencies confirm it, naming both a cloud storage library and an Azure Functions extension, so it is reasonable to infer, and this entry marks it as inference, that the library was written to run periodic cash-flow projections in the cloud.** **Fourth, the dependency set dates the package**: a CSV library, an Azure Functions extension at a beta version, a compression library at an alpha version and a cloud storage library, targeting .NET Core 2.0 — **a project from 2018 on early .NET Core and Azure Functions, with two of its four dependencies on pre-release versions**. **Fifth, there is no licence, no repository and no project page**, all three fields being absent. **Under the default rules of copyright an undeclared licence means all rights are reserved, so the package can be downloaded five thousand times without that meaning anyone may use or redistribute it — the same silent-licence shape this session has recorded before, now appearing in an enterprise registry.** **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover cash-flow projection and model libraries, mostly in the Python and R ecosystems, **and a pooled entry with a similar name is a Python stochastic modelling library rather than a .NET class library, so this entry states explicitly that the two are different artefacts and makes no comparison between them; while this entry supplies an actuarial cash-flow engine in the .NET ecosystem with no publicly readable documentation at all. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **three inequalities are worth remembering — a download count is not availability; code inside a package is not the same as code a reader can understand; and matching type names are not matching definitions, since the same cash-flow model name can mean different projection assumptions at different institutions. A practical reminder follows: before reusing such a library, settle the licence and the maintenance responsibility first, and discuss definitions second.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed and none of its methods was called**, so no cash-flow projection was run and no annuity or reserve was computed, **and no claim is made that any feature works, that any result is correct or that the framework design is sound**. **Second, the type names come from binary strings, two hundred and seven of them, and this entry states explicitly that they are clues rather than an API contract**, no reflection having been performed, so the visibility, signatures and call relationships of those types could not be confirmed. **Third, whether its algorithms conform to any actuarial standard was not verified**, including discounting, life table interpolation and inflation capping rules, **which is precisely what must be checked before use**. **Fourth, which mortality tables the two life data types point at was not verified, nor their source or licensing.** **Fifth, the licence is missing, and this entry does not claim the package may be freely used; that is a question for the user to settle with the rights holder.** **Sixth, the authors were not verified beyond two names appearing in the metadata, and this entry does not reproduce any institutional affiliation they might have. Seventh, any relationship between this package and a production system was not verified and is not speculated about here. Eighth, on the window: both versions were published in April 2018, far outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is an actuarial cash-flow engine in the .NET ecosystem with downloads in the thousands while its licence, its repository and its documentation are all absent at once. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the package is not a licensed actuarial opinion and that its assumptions and algorithms must be independently reviewed before use.**
